# Jimwel Cruz — Full-Stack Developer

> Complete profile of Jimwel Cruz, a full-stack developer based in the Philippines, building performant, user-friendly digital experiences with React, Next.js, Node.js, PHP, and Shopify since 2023.

## Profile

Jimwel Cruz is a full-stack web developer based in the Philippines. He has been building production web applications since 2023, working across the full stack — database design and API development through polished, responsive user interfaces.

His focus is on performant, user-friendly digital experiences: fast load times, accessible markup, clean interfaces, and conversion-focused e-commerce flows. He is available for freelance work and open to discussing new opportunities.

## Services

### Full-Stack Development

Building complete, production-ready web applications from database to interface. This includes designing database schemas, building RESTful APIs, implementing authentication and authorization, and delivering responsive front ends with React and Next.js.

### E-commerce Development

Creating Shopify and custom online stores that convert visitors into customers. This covers theme customization, product catalog architecture, cart and checkout flows, payment integration, and performance tuning for stores that scale during traffic spikes.

### UI Implementation

Turning designs into pixel-perfect, responsive interfaces using modern frameworks. Working from Figma or other design files, delivering component systems that match the intended visual design at every breakpoint.

### Performance Optimization

Improving load times and Lighthouse scores for a faster, smoother experience. This includes code splitting, image optimization, caching strategies, bundle analysis, and Core Web Vitals tuning.

### Accessibility Audits

Reviewing and fixing usability so everyone can navigate and use your website. Conducting WCAG-oriented reviews of keyboard navigation, screen-reader support, color contrast, and focus management, then implementing fixes.

### Responsive Design

Designing websites that look and perform equally well on all devices and screen sizes. Mobile-first layouts that preserve content and interaction quality from a 320px phone to a 4K monitor.

## AI & Tools

### AI-Assisted Development

Using AI coding agents and LLM-powered tools to accelerate development — from scaffolding and debugging to code review and architecture decisions. AI does not replace judgment; it amplifies it.

### Vibe Coding

Rapidly prototyping ideas by iterating with AI in real time. Describing what you want, refining the output, and shipping faster — turning concepts into working code through natural conversation.

### AI-Augmented Workflow

From generating boilerplate to optimizing performance, integrating AI into every stage of the development lifecycle so the creative and strategic parts get the attention they need.

## Selected Work

### Marrow — Streetwear Label Design Study

https://marrow-silk.vercel.app/

Homepage design study for a streetwear label. Cinematic ink-and-ivory art direction with oversized editorial type, film-grain photography, and a seven-section single-page flow.

### FoxHound Bee — Apiary Design Study

https://foxhound-bee.vercel.app/

Homepage design study for a fictional apiary. Warm cream-and-ember paper palette, a rationed orange accent, a hexagonal comb grid, and a hand-drawn icon sprite.

### crumb. — Cupcake Shop Design Study

https://crumb-drab.vercel.app/

Homepage design study for a fictional cupcake shop. Cream-and-dough palette, hand-drawn ink outlines, scalloped section seams, and a real-time 3D hero.

### Vellora — Multi-Vendor Marketplace

https://vellora-seven.vercel.app/

Multi-vendor marketplace for thoughtfully made products. Full-stack build with Next.js, Stripe, real-time notifications, and role-based dashboards.

### ModernHaven — E-commerce Store for Modern Furniture

https://modern-haven-nine.vercel.app/

A production e-commerce store for modern furniture, demonstrating product catalog organization, cart and checkout flows, and polished responsive design.

### ContactFlow — CRM Platform

https://contactflow-crm.vercel.app/

A CRM platform for managing customer interactions, showcasing data modeling, list and detail views, and interaction tracking in a full-stack application.
